title: 星期六的熱乾麵
mood: warm, a little nervous, quietly proud
subject: learning to make his girlfriend's Wuhan hometown breakfast, hot dry noodles, every Saturday and never quite getting it right
caption: Mandarin Britpop with mid-90s British guitar-band swagger. A jangly twelve-string electric guitar ringing open chords; a crunchy rhythm guitar on the backbeat; a melodic bass walking under the changes; tambourine and straight rock drums; a Hammond organ pad entering on the last chorus. Warm and roomy, guitars wide, the voice centred and dry. Male baritone-tenor, plain and sincere with a slightly nasal tone, an easy singalong chorus. 112 BPM, D major. Warm, a little nervous, quietly proud. No synth pads, no R&B runs, no autotune, no trap drums, no power-ballad key change.
lyrics:
[Intro - jangly twelve-string guitar and tambourine]

[Verse 1]
妳說武漢的早上是芝麻醬的味道
我買了鹼水麵 照著影片一步步做
第一碗太乾 第二碗太鹹
妳還是吃完 說下禮拜再來

[Pre-Chorus]
週六八點 鍋子比妳先醒
妳在被子裡數我又失敗幾次

[Chorus]
就算我一輩子拌不出妳家巷口那一碗
我還是每個星期六 把芝麻醬調開
妳說差一點 我說那就下次
差一點 剛好留給我們慢慢來

[Verse 2]
第十個星期六 我加了蘿蔔丁
妳站在廚房門口 一句話也不說
吃到一半 妳打給妳媽
說有個人 麵煮得還可以

[Pre-Chorus]
電話那頭笑得好大聲
我假裝洗碗 把水開到最大

[Chorus - organ enters]
就算我一輩子拌不出妳家巷口那一碗
我還是每個星期六 把芝麻醬調開
妳說今天這碗 差不多了
差不多 就夠我再煮好幾十年

[Outro - guitars ring out]
下個週六 妳說換妳來煮
我坐在旁邊 負責說差一點
